notes: operator note: 1 Sep: selection.iv_rank_no_trade_above is OFF (1.01) and premium_gate.iv_rank_min is OFF (0.0). IV rank is pinned at 100% on every symbol because runs/judged/iv_history.json mixes two estimators - 251 seeded days from IVModel over daily PRICE bars (a realized-vol proxy) against a live observation of option-implied ATM vol. Implied sits above realized by the variance risk premium, so the live print lands at the top of its own history and the percentile resolves to 1.0. Measured: on 15 of 20 symbols the last value IS the series maximum. The intraday ceiling was refusing 74 of 154 live candidates on that number; the carry floor was passing everything on it. Both gates are off deliberately - do NOT recommend re-tuning either until the history is rebuilt on one basis. See claude/iv-rank-pinned-by-a-basis-mismatch.md.

bullets: Increase intraday momentum sizing threshold from 1.0% to 1.2% of equity to allow trades like QQQ/IWM ($2,126–$2,486 loss) without violating risk limits.
Reserve capital for the carry book (e.g., $5,000) to enable vol_carry trades on DIA (rejected 2x due to "no reserved capital").
Expand IV rank data coverage: 112 rejections cited "no IV rank available," including for SPY/IWM/TLT. Prioritize fetching IV rank for liquid ETFs.
Adjust liquidity filter thresholds: 25+ rejections for SPY/IWM/TLT due to "no contracts survived." Log strike/IV spreads to identify filter tightness.
Lower IV rank no-trade ceiling from 85% to 90% for symbols hitting 100% (e.g., DIA in vol_carry ideas).
Shift intraday cycles to pre-11:30 or post-13:30 to avoid lunch window rejections (40+ hits between 12:34–13:03).
Audit "scheduled_event" gate: 126 rejections for "no qualifying catalyst," but no macro catalysts were logged in notes. Align event definitions with actual market context.
